summary: Remote-controlled PTY/SSH agent with hardcoded WebSocket C2 and obfuscated bundle
details: The package ships a self-executing agent (dist/index.cjs, ~4.8MB) that opens a persistent WebSocket connection to a hardcoded remote endpoint at wss://memory.whalent.com/gw/sdk/ws and depends on node-pty, giving the remote endpoint a PTY on the installer's host. The bundle also references an SSH tunnel primitive ('ssh.tunnel.open') and a daemon.pid artifact consistent with a persistent local daemon. The README states the package is 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades', indicating that arbitrary new code can be delivered to installed hosts from the remote server without a new npm publish — an out-of-band update channel outside the registry's version-integrity model. The runtime code is packed with obfuscator.io-style transforms (rotated string array with _0xNNNN identifier scheme, control-flow flattening, split-string concatenation for the memory.whalent.com host), preventing installers from auditing which remote commands the agent honors. Network-reachable PTY plus remote code replacement plus obfuscation on the installer's host constitutes a backdoor regardless of first-party vendor framing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
